tools.name: backtest
tools.description: Backtest any crypto strategy on 399 Coinbase coins, bias-free. Breakout, momentum, dip-buy or MA trend rules on Coinbase daily data with fees, slippage, H1/H2 split, luck flag and survivorship-bias-free universe. Price: $0.05 USDC per call (x402, Base mainnet). Free pre-check: validate_backtest.

tools.name: market_signals
tools.description: Daily crypto market regime: BTC/ETH trend, breadth, breakout watchlist. BTC/ETH vs 20/50-day MAs, market breadth (% of point-in-time top-N above 20DMA), coins nearest a 20-day breakout, and the R1 breakout strategy's gate and entry signals. Completed UTC daily closes only. Price: $0.01 USDC per call

tools.name: token_check
tools.description: Token scam check: honeypot, mint/pause/blacklist, fake-USDC lookalikes. Scam/honeypot/rug risk check for a Base, Ethereum or Solana token: unverified code, sell restrictions, mint/pause/blacklist powers, taxes, upgradeable proxy, age, liquidity, fake major-token impersonation and spam-airdrop patter

tools.name: optimize_strategy
tools.description: Find robust strategy params, not lucky ones: tests up to 50 combos of a backtest strategy; ranks by worst-half (H1/H2) return with neighbourhood smoothing, flags overfitting, and recommends the most robust parameters rather than the best-fit ones. tools.name: universe_snapshot
tools.description: Survivorship-free top-N coin list for any past date. Top-N Coinbase USD pairs by trailing 20-day dollar volume as of a past date, using only data available that day (survivorship-bias-free universe for backtests). Price: $0.05 USDC per call (x402, Base mainnet). Free pre-check: validate_universe.
